description: Rogue Engine Editor customization: dockable ECS inspector, local-server play mode, and art asset pipeline — one shell, three inspectors
name: @mmo-engine/editor

scripts.build: npm run build:deps && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.build:deps: npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/rules && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/species && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/modules && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/scene && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/engine-core && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/art && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/mirror && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/dungeon && npm run build:deps --workspace=@mmo-engine/client && npm run build:lib --workspace=@mmo-engine/client
